clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Bailor Stonehand’s forge work has been set back by stolen ore. The skilled dwarven smith once taught the human weaponsmith Jordan Stilwell and makes a specialized alloy for masterwork arms.

Bailor Stonehand works the forge in Thelsamar, where his knowledge of minerals and specialized alloys reaches beyond Khaz Modan. He once taught Jordan Stilwell, a human smith, the foundations of metallurgy and shared formulas used to forge blessed paladin weapons such as Verigan's Fist.

Mo'grosh ogres in the hills northeast of Thelsamar have stolen ore shipments meant for Bailor's forge. Without the raw material, he cannot make his rare alloys, and needs travelers and allies to recover the supplies from the ogres' encampments.
